title: How Much Does a Bathroom Remodel Cost in Massachusetts? (2026 North Shore Guide)
metaTitle: Bathroom Remodel Cost in Massachusetts (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: What a bathroom remodel really costs on the North Shore in 2026: typical price ranges, where the money goes, and the hidden items that blow budgets.
secondaryKeywords: how much does a bathroom remodel cost

faq.q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Massachusetts in 2026?
faq.a: Most full bathroom remodels in Essex and Middlesex County fall between $20,000 and $45,000 for a mid-range project. Cosmetic refreshes typically start around $10,000, and full gut remodels with layout changes can reach $80,000 or more. These are typical ranges; your actual number depends on scope, materials and the condition of the plumbing and subfloor.

faq.q: What is the average bathroom remodel cost for an older North Shore home?
faq.a: Older homes usually land in the middle to upper part of the range because of hidden conditions: rotten subfloor under the tub, outdated plumbing, missing ventilation and wiring that must be brought to code. A contractor experienced with older New England houses can anticipate most of these in the estimate.

faq.q: How much does it cost to replace a bathtub?
faq.a: Bathtub replacement typically costs between $3,500 and $10,000 installed in our area, depending on the tub, the surround or tile and any repairs needed underneath. Converting a tub to a walk-in shower usually runs from about $9,000 to $20,000.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to remodel a bathroom in Massachusetts?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. If the work touches plumbing, electrical or framing, Massachusetts generally requires permits, often a building permit plus plumbing and electrical permits. A licensed contractor handles them, and the cost should appear in your estimate.

faq.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
faq.a: A typical full bathroom remodel takes three to six weeks once work begins, depending on tile work, material lead times and whether plumbing or walls are being moved. Your estimate should include a clear schedule by phase.

faq.q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost per square foot?
faq.a: Because bathrooms have many fixed costs in a small space, they cost more per square foot than most rooms. A small hall bath with a mid-range remodel often lands roughly between $450 and $900 per square foot on the North Shore, while larger primary baths often land roughly between $300 and $650. Use these numbers as a sanity check, not as a budget.

faq.q: Is a condo bathroom remodel different in Massachusetts?
faq.a: The construction is similar, but condo projects usually require association approval, proof of the contractor's insurance, limited work hours and coordination for shared plumbing risers and elevators. Read your association documents first and share them with your contractor so the estimate reflects the building's rules.
